summary: On Holding AG filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, furnishing a press release and management's discussion and analysis for first quarter 2026 results. The filing reports record net sales of CHF 831.9 million (+14.5% YoY, +26.4% constant currency), gross profit margin of 64.2%, and adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.0%. The company reiterates FY2026 constant currency net sales growth guidance of at least 23% and raises profitability outlook. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
